source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"job","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${input.jobNo}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"job","error_code":"JOB_NOT_FOUND","error_message":"Job order not found"},{"type":"failIfNotEquals","var":"job.dispatch_status","equals":"RUNNING","error_code":"INVALID_STATE","error_message":"Job order must be RUNNING"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"spec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${job.segment_id}","${input.definitionId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"spec","error_code":"MATERIAL_NOT_IN_SEGMENT_SPEC","error_message":"Material is not a produced output of the job segment"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"input.lotId","error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"lotId is required"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"input.barcode","error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"barcode is required"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"def","sql":"SELECT base_uom FROM emc_material_definition WHERE definition_id = ?","params":["${input.definitionId}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${input.lotId}","${input.barcode}","${input.definitionId}","${input.storageLocation}","${input.quantity}","${def.base_uom}","${input.barcode}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"resp","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${input.jobNo}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"resp","error_code":"NO_RUNNING_RESPONSE","error_message":"No running response for job order"},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${resp.response_id}","${input.lotId}","${input.definitionId}","${input.quantity}","${def.base_uom}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_matlot_produce-step.sql","params":["${input.lotId}","${resp.response_id}","${input.lotId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lotId":"${input.lotId}","jobNo":"${input.jobNo}","producedQty":"${input.quantity}"}}]}
